Title: Azure Data Explorer deployment into Azure Virtual Networks now generally available

Body.Content:
Deployment of an Azure Data Explorer into a virtual network is now generally available. Use this capability to:

  • Enforce network security group (NSG) rules on your Azure Data Explorer cluster traffic.
  • Connect your on-premises network to Azure Data Explorer cluster's subnet.
  • Secure your data connection sources (Azure Event Hub and Azure Event Grid) with service endpoints.

Learn more.
